axiom-gatekeeper.blurb: Checks outbound messaging calls against your own rules (STOP, consent, quiet hours, no double-texting, approved wording) before they run, and holds or denies the call when a check fails.
axiom-gatekeeper.entry_description: Checks outbound messaging tool calls against your own rules before they run, and holds or denies the call when a check fails.

axiom-standing.blurb: Keeps a local record of checks that passed or failed, refuses to mark a task done until a check passes, and asks for approval when an agent acts above its level.
axiom-standing.entry_description: Earned trust for agent workers: independent proof checks, a local record, and level-based approval gates.

axiom-tripwire.blurb: Writes one private log line each time Claude Code refuses a tool call. It only observes: it never blocks, approves or changes a call.
axiom-tripwire.entry_description: Writes one private log line each time Claude Code refuses a tool call. Observes only; never blocks or approves.

axiom-run-receipts.blurb: Writes one private receipt per session or headless run: when it ran, how many tool calls were seen, how many were reported as failed, and how the run ended.
axiom-run-receipts.entry_description: Writes one private receipt per Claude Code session or headless run: outcome and tool counts, never arguments, results or text.

axiom-declines.blurb: Remembers a permission request you declined and stops Claude Code asking for the same thing again.
axiom-declines.entry_description: Remembers a permission request you declined and stops Claude Code asking for the same thing again.

axiom-axioma.blurb: Colors the few phrases in Claude's reply that deserve a second look, and shows an advisory card before a send, spend, spin or scrub call. Advice only, never consent.
axiom-axioma.entry_description: Colors the few phrases in Claude's reply that deserve a second look, and shows an advisory card before a send, spend, spin or scrub call. Advice only, never consent.

axiom-chiron.blurb: Reads how much you know about a topic from your own words, with no model call, and adds one short note per turn telling Claude how to talk to you. Off until you turn it on.
axiom-chiron.entry_description: Reads your level on each topic from your own words, with no model call, and tells Claude how to talk to you.

axiom-agent.blurb: The nine-article Axiom Doctrine as two skills, plus a status report of which articles have an enabled enforcer plugin. It enforces nothing itself.
axiom-agent.entry_description: The nine-article Axiom Doctrine as skills, with a status report of which articles have an enabled enforcer plugin. Enforces nothing itself.

axiom-coach.blurb: Skills for working a coach's desk and a self-serve plan through the open coach app's own connector, plus the three Lite calculators as written rules.
axiom-coach.entry_description: Skills for the open coach app's connector (coach desk, self-serve plan, connect, deploy) and the Lite calculators as written rules. Skills only.

axiom-coach-lite.blurb: Three local calculators: a training split, daily macro targets (five health questions first), and a cardio calorie estimate. No network, no files.
axiom-coach-lite.entry_description: The three Lite calculators (split, macros, cardio) as local tools for Claude Code, run as a mod. No network, no files.
